name: claude-md-packs
description: The claude-md configuration as plugins: install the base engineering team, then add the marketing and council packs per project as needed. The security baseline (settings.json) is a separate classic install — see setup.md.

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Core engineering team — 23 least-privilege, zero-network agents (planning, review, implementation, debugging, testing, devops, docs, curated stack experts) plus the /caveman terse-output skill. The main install; pair it with the settings.json security baseline (see setup.md).

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: 7 marketing & content agents — conversion-copywriter, content-writer, content-editor, email-campaign-writer, growth-strategist, and the config's only two network-enabled agents: content-researcher (Tavily search) and seo-rank-monitor (DataForSEO), both read-only on files.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: The 6-seat decision council (optimist, pessimist, out-of-the-box, skeptic, pragmatist, chair) plus the /council skill that fans a question to the seats and synthesizes a verdict. Pure reasoners — no network, no file writes.
